parties: Bharat Gears Limited (investor) in Hexa Energy HR5 Private Limited
headline: Bharat Gears invests ₹1.27 cr in Hexa Energy HR5 for solar power procurement compliance
sum: Bharat Gears Limited has acquired a 29.55% equity stake in Hexa Energy HR5 Private Limited for ₹1.27 crore, comprising 13,134 equity shares at ₹970 per share. The investment is structured to meet electricity regulatory requirements for solar power procurement across the company's Faridabad and Mumbra manufacturing units.
implication: Strategic minority equity investment by a listed industrial manufacturer in a renewable energy Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) to satisfy renewable purchase obligation (RPO) or green tariff mandates under the Electricity Act 2003 and state-level grid codes—a common structuring approach for captive or semi-captive solar procurement.
detail: Bharat Gears Limited, a listed auto-components and gearbox manufacturer, has made a minority equity investment of ₹1,27,39,980 in Hexa Energy HR5 Private Limited, acquiring 13,134 equity shares at an issue price of ₹970 each, representing 29.55% of the investee's paid-up share capital. The investment is disclosed under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 as a material related-party or significant transaction. The stated purpose is compliance with applicable electricity laws governing solar power procurement for the company's manufacturing facilities in Faridabad and Mumbra. This structure is typical where an off-taker (Bharat Gears) takes a minority stake in a dedicated renewable energy SPV to secure long-term green power supply and meet statutory renewable purchase obligations (RPO) or achieve net-zero / carbon-neutral manufacturing targets. The transaction appears to be a build-to-suit or PPower Purchase Agreement (PPA) support structure.
